requestedIntent: Reduce Full BMAD execution time without removing independent semantic controls by eliminating model-driven bookkeeping, reusing only the story Developer session, and bounding reviewer context with raw hash-bound capsules.
limitations: V327-CAL-001 qualifies gpt-5.6-sol/medium only for Code Review. ATDD, Development, Patch Assurance, and Judge roles retain gpt-5.6-sol/high until role-specific evidence exists.

A review capsule is additive transport and cannot replace independent reviewer judgment or targeted reads needed to resolve a named uncertainty; a reviewer may rerun the focused command only for a named evidence conflict.

The runtime is enforced by schemas, writers, validators, tests, and installer wiring. V3.32 live-proved the one-shot correction, nested product contract, durable story-close ordering, independent reviews, Epic Judge, and artifact-only blind product PASS; its immutable row failed only on a corrected read-only shell-inspection scorer false positive. V3.33 then exposed an unsafe conductor-facing integration display string: an unquoted pipe produced exit 127 before the correctly quoted retry passed, violating exactly-once integration. The compiled contract now emits one typed shell-safe integration action and forbids reconstruction or retry after nonzero, but this successor repair has not yet passed a live proof. The capability therefore remains enforced rather than proven and target repositories have not yet been updated.

V3.31's immutable story-close package was committed after integration and included pre-dispatch capsules. The repaired supervisor now emits one exact capsule-free close commit and story-transition rejects any uncommitted or malformed package, but immutable V3.31 remains PRODUCT_PASS_PROCESS_FAIL.
Existing Full runs with lifecycle evidence cannot adopt this runtime contract in place.
